title: Design System: Anthony Freda, the booster pack

ground.purpose: The page, html background, theme-color, stuck header and the phone inspect bar. Dark only: there is no light theme.

ground-2.purpose: Highlight tiles, the inspect text panel, art placeholders.

reveal-plum.purpose: Centre of the reveal stage's radial backdrop.

reveal-deep.purpose: Edge of the reveal stage's radial backdrop.

lamp.purpose: The one accent: every Email me, Rip here, focus ring, selection, rarity note; the middle stop of the foil button ramp.

lamp-hover.purpose: Middle stop of the brighter hover ramp on primary buttons.

ink.purpose: Headings, current-employer wordmark, the DigitalOcean scope line.

muted.purpose: Dates, labels, the pack hint, the inspect count, the footer.

card-ink.purpose: Text on cards and on amber buttons.

card-soft.purpose: Flavour text and the card foot.

card-back.purpose: The card back's frame, around the back illustration and the AF medallion.

pack-print.purpose: Behind the pack art before it loads.

pack-stroke.purpose: The plum stroke under the wrapper's name.

type-platform.purpose: Type colour: Yum Brands, Movement Mortgage, Diligent.

type-partner.purpose: Type colour: the player card, About, Skills, Contact.

holo-silver.purpose: Secret-rare frame base under the rainbow film.

rule.purpose: Row and skills dividers, stuck-header hairline, inspect footer line.

lamp-highlight.purpose: Top stop of the foil button ramp.

lamp-lip.purpose: Bottom stop of the foil button ramp: the darker lower lip.

keyline-gold.purpose: The gold keyline just inside every card frame.

chip-fill.purpose: Soft fill of secondary buttons and the inspect Close.

pack-brand.purpose: The name printed on the wrapper; the page's h1.

display.purpose: The Say hello heading in the closing band.

headline.purpose: Section titles (Recent work, Experience, Cards, About me, Skills); inspect h2 at clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 3rem).

card-name.purpose: The big name on every card, with the stat top-right; nothing sits above it.

card-body.purpose: Flavour and move text on a card.

body.purpose: Page copy; 16px at 860px and below; 62ch cap on leads.

lead.purpose: Experience leads, about copy, the ask subline.

label.purpose: Nav, hints, counters, Copy and compact buttons; standard buttons at 700 17px.

pack-label.purpose: Title pill and pack foot; the only uppercase tracked text.

tile-headline.purpose: The written headline on a recent-work tile; larger on the 2x2 tile, smaller on squares.

opening-line.purpose: The one-sentence line under the pack.

shadows.name: soft-chip

shadows.name: held-card

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Card flip and springback.

motion.purpose: Light floods out of the tear.

motion.name: rip-flash
motion.purpose: One white frame falling away.

motion.name: rip-kick
motion.purpose: Screen kick on the rip.

motion.name: auto-rip
motion.purpose: Tap / Enter / Rip here tear duration.

motion.name: card-rise
motion.purpose: The reveal stack enters.

motion.name: card-throw
motion.purpose: A card flicked off the stack.

motion.name: card-flip

motion.purpose: WebGL flap tumbling away.

motion.name: gl-give-up

motion.name: secret-shock
motion.purpose: Ring of light crossing the screen on the payoff.

motion.name: turn-2d
motion.purpose: The secret rare's 2D turn on phones and Safari.

motion.purpose: Header sticks past 70% of the viewport.

narrative.overview:
The first viewport is a night table with one warm lamp over it, and on it a sealed foil booster pack printed with the page's h1 (the name) and the title. The visitor rips it open. Twelve collectible cards, one per resume section, rise out of the pack and are flicked through one at a time. Then the spectacle stops. Everything below the pack is a calm, scannable landing page on the same plum-black ground. It sells in a fixed order: where he has worked, four pieces of recent work, the experience, one plain ask, the cards, about me, skills, and a closing Say hello band. On that page the colour comes from the card art and the six type colours. The chrome stays dark and quiet, and one lamp-amber accent marks every action.

There are two registers. The pack and the reveal are violent, glossy and physical: foil, crinkle, light, shards, a heartbeat and haptics. The page under them is editorial and restrained: rows, rules, tags and plain lists. The cards join the two registers, because the same printed card face appears in the reveal, in inspect and in the Say hello band, and the cards row shows each card as art and name. All content is real HTML and is server-rendered under the pack, so the page is complete without WebGL, without JavaScript motion, and on paper.

The world is dark only: there is no light theme (`color-scheme: dark`, theme-color the ground). It refuses the one-page scroll of hero, about, timeline and contact. It also refuses synthwave and neon, generic dark-neon glow, and any Pokémon trade dress (no yellow border, no logos, no names).
keyCharacteristics: A plum-black ground (never pure black), dark only, with a single warm lamp pool behind the pack.
One accent, lamp amber, struck like foil on every primary action, and used for the focus ring and the selection.
Six card type colours carry all the hue below the fold, through card frames, row tints, tags and art borders.
Bricolage Grotesque, heavy and narrowed on its width axis, for every name and heading; Onest for everything you read.
A WebGL foil pack that tears for real, and a reveal where every card comes out face up except the secret rare, which gets a build-up and a payoff.
Cards are printed objects: foil frame, gold keyline, paper grain, and art with a print finish.
Every card opens into inspect, which shows a big tilting card beside its full text.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Lamp amber is the only accent on the chrome. Each viewport has one primary Email me at most, plus the sticky one. No second accent appears.

rules.name: The Type Owns the Hue Rule
rules.body: Below the pack, saturated colour appears only through a card type: its art, its frame, its row tint and its tags. Nothing decorative gets a colour of its own.

rules.name: The Narrow Heavy Rule
rules.body: Display type is weight 700–800 with `wdth` between 75 and 90. Bricolage is never set at its default width or a light weight.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section titles stand alone. No uppercase eyebrows sit above them, and no line sits above a card name. Uppercase tracking belongs to the printed pack only.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Every highlight and spill is warm and comes from the lamp or from inside the pack. The lamp is one warm radial layer; there is no second, coloured lamp layer. Cool light appears only as the violet and teal rim lights in WebGL and in the secret rare's rainbow foil.

dos: Do keep lamp amber as the one accent, on Email me, focus, selection and rarity notes only.
Do strike primary buttons as foil (ramp, top edge, lower lip, one glint on hover) and keep secondaries as soft chips, on the 60/52/44 tiers.
Do colour anything that belongs to a job through its card type (`--t` / `--frame`) and OKLab mixes of it.
Do size everything on a card in `cqw`, so one card face serves the reveal, the cards row, inspect and the band.
Do give every mailto the subject "Hello from antfreda.com" (`src/lib/contact.ts`).
Do set display type in Bricolage 700–800 narrowed (`wdth` 75–90), and read-text in Onest.
Do trace every claim to the approved resume copy or a fact Anthony confirmed (`Chapter.scope`). Tile headlines are plain restatements, never new claims.
Do run new card art through `scripts/print-finish.mjs` so it reads as printed.
Do bring cards out face up. Only the secret rare arrives face down, with its build-up and payoff.
Do keep the spectacle above the fold and the page below it calm, scannable and complete as HTML, with no WebGL, under reduced motion and in print.
Do keep one working Email me reachable at all times: hero, sticky header or dock, the ask and the band.
donts: Don't print the dog's name anywhere except the About me line (`profile.home` in `resume.ts`). Copy, alt text, labels and metadata call it a French bulldog.
Don't write corny copy. Use plain, direct, first-person wording close to the resume, with no puns, no game-speak and no hype.
Don't give an employer card a rarity. Only the player card is rare and only the Contact card is the secret rare.
Don't put a line, kicker or eyebrow above a card name or a section title.
Don't use Pokémon trade dress: no yellow border, logos or names.
Don't go synthwave, neon or generic dark-glow. The light is one warm lamp, with no coloured second lamp layer.
Don't add a light theme. The world is dark only.
Don't add a second accent colour, or give a decorative element a hue of its own.
Don't use pure black for the ground or hard offset shadows anywhere.
Don't autoplay sound, or play any sound or vibration under reduced motion or when muted.
Don't show unverified metrics, degrees, testimonials or private details on a card or tile.
